description: Poll one video task for its machine-readable progress: returns {task_id, state, progress, stage, error}. error is the engine failure reason when state is -1 (failed), null otherwise. Use for the video after generate_persona_video; prefer this over get_video_status when only progress matters. Prefer wait_for_video_tasks when you need the final outcome instead of progress snapshots.
name: get_video_task_progress
